paite: Huan TOUPA'N Noah kiang ah, "Nang leh na inkuanpih tengteng long ah lutta un. Nang zaw hiai khang a ka ma ah midiktat na hih ka hon mu hi.
heading: Tuichim
english: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

paite: Sa siang chiteng lak ah anu leh apa, kop sagih zel; sa siang lou lak ah anu leh apa chiat toh kop nih zel, na kiang ah na pi ding ahi.
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

paite: Tung a leng vasa lak ah leng, anu leh apa chiat, kop sagih zel in; leitung a chi khah ding a hinsak ding in.
english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

paite: Ni sagih in asam lai a, huai khit chiang in leitung ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli sung vuah ka zusak ding a; ka bawl thil hing chiteng leitung a kipan ka hihmang ding," achi hi.
english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

paite: Noah in TOUPA'N akiang a thu apiak tengteng ahi bangbang in ahihta hi.
english: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

paite: Leitung a tuichim ahong tun lai in, Noah kum zaguk a upa ahita hi.
english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

paite: Tuichim atun ding ziak in long ah Noah alut a, atapate leh azi leh atapate' zite leng akiang ah alut chiat uhi.
english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

paite: Sa siang lak ah leng, sa siang lou lak ah leng, vasa lak ah leng, leitung a bokvak a pai chiteng lak ah leng,
english: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

paite: Pathian in Noah kiang a thu apiak bang in, anu leh apa chiat, akopkop in, Noah kiang ah long ah alut uhi.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

paite: Huan ni sagih nung in leitung ah tuichim atungta hi.
english: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

paite: Noah kum zaguk ahih kum, akha nihna, ani sawm-le-sagih ni in, huai ni mah in tui thuk zapi nak tengteng ahong puakzak a, van tohlette leng hong kihongta uhi.
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

paite: Ni sawmli leh zan sawmli sung teng leitung ah vuahpi azuta hi.
english: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

paite: Huai ni mah in long ah Noah leh Noah tapate Shem, Ham, Japheth leh Noah zi alut ua, atapate zi thumte leng akiang ah alut uhi.
english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

paite: Amaute alut ua, sa chiteng amau chi omdan dungzui zel in, ganhing leitung a bokvak a pai chiteng amau chi omdan dungzui zel in, vasa chiteng, amau chi omdan dungzui zel in, vasa chiteng, kha nei chiteng leng alut uhi.
english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

paite: Sa tengteng hinna hatna pai himhimte, akopkop in Noah kiang ah long ah alut uhi.
english: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

paite: Alutte Pathian in akiang a thu apiak bang in, sa tengteng lak a anu leh apa zel in alut uhi. Huchi in TOUPA'N amah akhakkhumta hi.
english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.

paite: Leitung ah ni sawmli sung teng tuichim atung a; tui ahong khang a, long alam a, leitung ah adomkangta hi.
english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

paite: Tui ahong om zuazua a, leitung ah akhan in ahong khang a, tui tung ah long akilam hi.
english: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

paite: Leitung ah tui nakpi in ahong om zuazua a; van nuai a tang sang tengtengte atum khin vekta hi.
english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

paite: Tong sawm-le-nga hial a sang in tui ahong om a; tangte tupmang in a-omta uhi.
english: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

paite: Lei a tang thei sa chiteng, vasate, gante, gamsate, ganhing lei a bokvak a pai chitengte, michih tengte toh asi khin vek uhi.
english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

paite: Anak ua hinna kha hatna omna tengteng, gam a om tengteng asi khin vek uhi.
english: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

paite: Leitung a thil hing chiteng omte, mite, gante, ganhingte, tung a leng vasate toh hihmang in a-om ua; lei a kipan hihman in a-omta ua, long sung a om Noah leh akiang a omte kia hawi in a-om uhi.
english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

paite: Ni za-le-sawmnga sung teng leitung ah tui avung hi.
english: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
